title: Craftable Villager Spawn Egg
description: This datapack adds the crafting recipe that lets players create a Villager Spawn Egg using rare and valuable items.
body: This data pack introduces a balanced late-game recipe for crafting a Villager Spawn Egg, requiring 1 Totem of Undying, 1 Enchanted Golden Apple, and 7 Emerald Blocks—perfect for technical players, map makers, or survival worlds that want controlled villager access without commands.
